desc:
Cursed Techniques + Ragdoll Physics. What could go wrong?

-CURSED TECHNIQUES-
🌀Play as the Honored One or the Cursed Vessel
🩸NEW: the Blood Manipulator, out now in Early Access
🤚Grab, throw and SLAM ragdolls into the ground
🌌Trap people inside your domain

-RAGDOLLS-
😵Flinch, stumble, break bones and get knocked out
👊Push them too far and they FIGHT BACK

-ARSENAL-
⚔️26 weapons: katanas, bows, guns, chainsaws, grenades, C4 and more
🔓Unlock stronger weapons the more ragdolls you take down
🚀Miniguns, rocket launchers, laser rifles and a lightning staff

👥Full MULTIPLAYER - cause chaos with your friends


Tags: Realistic ragdoll physics sandbox, Shoot, blast and grab ragdolls, slow-mo, dont splash, survival, simulation, locust, Jujutsu
